# A file already guarded by -split (//go:build !goexperiment.simd) is left untouched.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func MulFloat32s(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * b[i]
	}
}
